title: Tensor compatibility of a ringed square on ordinary module sheaves
statement: Let Y,X,Y′,X′ be small ringed tensor corners, let f:Y→X, g:Y→Y′, h:X→X′, k:Y′→X′ be ringed tensor edges, and let s be a ringed tensor square as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation]. Write μ_e for the ordinary tensor comparison of edge e, with its pure-tensor normalization [def-weil-pbc-canonical-ringed-tensor-comparison]. For every two Y-module sheaves M,N, the following equality of X′-linear module-sheaf morphisms holds: s.modules_(M⊗N);h*(μ_f(M,N));μ_h(f*M,f*N) = k*(μ_g(M,N));μ_k(g*M,g*N);(s.modules_M⊗s.modules_N). No flatness hypothesis and no derived or complex input occurs.

proof.text: Evaluate the two composites on iterated scalar insertions of generalized pure tensors. The canonical pure-tensor equations for all four edges express their outputs as tensors of iterated insertions.

Apply the insertion equation for s separately to the two factors. Naturality of s.sets with respect to the generalized sections and preservation of their binary product by inverse image identify these tensors.

Scalar-extension and tensor universal properties extend equality from inserted pure tensors to their scalar multiples and finite sums. The sheafification universal property then gives equality of module-sheaf morphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSquareModuleTensorCompatibility
    (s : RingedTensorSquare Y X Y' X' f g h k)
    (M N : SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose Y.topology (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj Y.ring)) :
    s.modules.hom.app ((monoidalCategory Y.ring).tensorObj M N) ≫
      h.pullback.map (f.ordinaryTensor.mu M N).hom ≫
      (h.ordinaryTensor.mu (f.pullback.obj M) (f.pullback.obj N)).hom =
    k.pullback.map (g.ordinaryTensor.mu M N).hom ≫
      (k.ordinaryTensor.mu (g.pullback.obj M) (g.pullback.obj N)).hom ≫
      (monoidalCategory X'.ring).tensorHom (s.modules.hom.app M) (s.modules.hom.app N)
